purpose: Diagnostic follow-up after the frozen NULL_COUPLED held-out falsification: ask what minimal pre-existing v3 structural addition can reproduce the 8-cell replication-stable support geometry without changing the v1 scalar-target ranking.
candidate_reason: Residual architecture is held at COUPLED because v1 selected it. The diagnostic changes only whether process predictors enter both scales or taxon means only, and whether within/among coefficient draws are shared or independent. CORE4-only families are omitted because they contain no process-extension coefficients and therefore cannot add the missing process structure beyond the frozen NULL baseline except through false-positive support.

support_test.multiplicity: omnibus unadjusted; BH across four block-specific tests within each threshold and biological scale
support_test.primary_cells: the same 8 replication-stable cells frozen in the held-out NULL validation

adequacy_rule.interpretation: A non-null family meeting all three conditions is called diagnostically adequate for the held-out support geometry. Failure of every family is an accepted endpoint.

stop_rule: Run the five-family 24-draw diagnostic once and freeze it. Do not change candidate membership, adequacy thresholds, seed count, permutation count, or minimality ordering because of the outcome. Any further mechanism refinement is a new version.
claim_boundary: This is a post-heldout diagnostic designed after seeing the NULL failure. It may identify a useful minimal next model class, but it is not confirmatory model selection and cannot change the frozen v1 scalar-target winner or establish a causal environmental process.
